claims.text: Many reviewers report the product does not power on or stops working, calling it defective.
Several reviewers complain about poor instructions with many spelling and grammatical errors.
Multiple reviewers say it does not work well on thick or curly hair, taking too long or leaving frizz.
Some reviewers report plug or outlet compatibility problems, including non-US plugs.
A few reviewers praise it as fast, easy, and good value, with one noting great customer service and a replacement.

qa.q: Does it really straighten thick curly hair?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: several reviewers say it does not work on thick curly hair [1][4][6], while one reviewer says it straightens their hair in minutes [5].

claims.text: It does not work well on thick curly hair and took an hour to poorly straighten a quarter of the hair [1].
It only works for thinner hair types or wavy hair and made thick wavy slightly curly hair frizzy [4].
It does not get hot enough for curly hair [6].
One reviewer says it straightens their hair in minutes [5].

qa.q: Is it safe for fine or damaged hair?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: How hot does it get and does it smell like burning?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on heat: some say it doesn't get hot enough [1][6] or loses heat [6], while others report the top gets extremely hot and caused burns [2], though one user said it didn't burn them [4]. No review mentions a burning smell.

claims.text: Some reviewers say it does not get hot enough or loses heat with use.
One reviewer reports the top part gets extremely hot and caused burns, while another says it did not burn them.

qa.q: Is it durable or does it break easily?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on durability: some report units arriving broken or parts falling off [1][6], while another reviewer had a defective first brush replaced quickly by customer service [5].

claims.text: Some reviewers report units arriving broken at the top and red tips falling off easily.
One reviewer had an issue with their first brush but it was replaced quickly by customer service.

qa.q: Is it worth the price compared to a regular straightener?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on value: one calls it a "Great Value" with a max temp higher than an average flat iron [5], and another says it straightens as well as a flat iron [4], but others say to save your money because it didn't straighten and loses heat [3], and one says it's slower than blow drying and straightening with a straightener [6].

claims.text: One reviewer calls it a "Great Value" and notes its max temp exceeds an average flat iron's [5].
One reviewer could barely tell the difference between hair straightened with a flat iron versus this brush [4].
Another reviewer says to save your money because it did not straighten and loses heat with each pass [3].
One reviewer says it took longer than blow drying and then straightening with a straightener [6].
